{"metadata":{"description":"DeepSeek Harness for VS Code: @dsh chat participant, sidebar & standalone chat, plan mode, goals, subagents, turn-level Git rollback, workspaces/jobs/settings panels, 13-language UI.","id":"gh:1333584467","install_available":false,"language":"JavaScript","name":"DeepSeek-Harness-for-VS-Code","slug":"NEXTINDIE/DeepSeek-Harness-for-VS-Code","topics":["ai","deepseek","deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","dsh-plugins","git"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"DeepSeek Harness for VS Code: @dsh chat participant, sidebar & standalone chat, plan mode, goals, su"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"bagents, turn-level Git rollback, workspaces/jobs/settings panels, 13-language UI."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# DeepSeek Harness for VS Code (dsh-vscode)"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"> **Before using this extension**: start the DeepSeek Harness server from your terminal first — the "},{"id":"p3s2","text":"extension connects to it inside VS Code.
>
[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"中文版 | Publisher: Jager · Latest: 0.13.69"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"Use DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`) directly in VS Code, alongside ChatGPT / Copilot: the built-in `@dsh` c"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"hat participant, secondary sidebar / standalone chat windows, workspaces / jobs / trajectory / setti"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"ngs panels, turn-level Git rollback, and a **multi-language UI** (简体中文 / 繁體中文 / English / 日本語 / 한국어 "},{"id":"p5s4","text":"/ Deutsch / Français / Español / Português / ไทย / Bahasa Indonesia / Türkçe / Русский / العربية — f"},{"id":"p5s5","text":"ollows the VS Code display language or switch manually)."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"- **Built-in chat participant `@dsh`**: type `@` in the native Chat panel (Ctrl+Alt+I); streamed rep"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"lies with tool calls and approval buttons; slash commands `/new`, `/session <ID>`, `/preset <name>`."},{"id":"p7s3","text":"
- **Secondary sidebar tab**: container appears in the Secondary Side Bar on VS Code ≥ 1.106 (falls "},{"id":"p7s4","text":"back to the Activity Bar on older versions).
- **Standalone chat window**: `DSH: Open Standalone Cha"},{"id":"p7s5","text":"t Window`.
- **Modern chat UI**: large rounded input box, pill toolbar (thinking depth / model / pre"},{"id":"p7s6","text":"set / permission), and a **context meter ring** at the top-right of the input box, right of the pres"},{"id":"p7s7","text":"et pill (web parity: click for "context used", the ~used / window reading, and the system-prompt / t"},{"id":"p7s8","text":"ool-definition / conversation breakdown with colour-coded bar segments and per-category token counts"},{"id":"p7s9","text":"). Below the input box sit two **session statistic pills** (web parity): `4 turns 285 steps · 267 to"},{"id":"p7s10","text":"k/s` (click for session statistics — LLM time, tool time, average TTFT, output TPS) and `71M tok · 9"},{"id":"p7s11","text":"9.6% cache hit` (click for token usage — exact total, cache hit, uncached input, cache read/write, o"},{"id":"p7s12","text":"utput).
- **Context-limit warnings stay in the conversation** (issue #19): the context ring turns am"},{"id":"p7s13","text":"ber at 75% and red at 90% (its panel then offers a one-click **Compact context**), and sending while"},{"id":"p7s14","text":" the next request would cross 90% of the window adds an in-conversation card with the projected read"},{"id":"p7s15","text":"ing plus **Compact context** / **Switch model**. If a turn still fails — the provider refuses with a"},{"id":"p7s16","text":" context-length error, or the model ends the turn with an error or at its output ceiling — the reaso"},{"id":"p7s17","text":"n is written into the conversation at that point instead of only flashing in a toast, so a model wit"},{"id":"p7s18","text":"h a smaller window (MiniMax and other pi-ai routes) never fails silently.
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"VS Code → Extensions → `…` → Install from VSIX → pick the file in `Releases\` → reload."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"Prerequisites: VS Code ≥ 1.90 (built-in chat ≥ 1.95; secondary sidebar container ≥ 1.106); DSH CLI o"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"r npx fallback; model credentials configured (same as `dsh web`)."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## Usage highlights"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"- The send shortcut is configurable, in place: **Settings → ⌨️ Sending & input** (or `dsh.sendKey` i"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"n `settings.json`) picks Enter (default), Ctrl+Enter or Shift+Enter to send — the other combination "},{"id":"p13s3","text":"inserts a newline. The pill on the composer hint line always shows the active binding and switches i"},{"id":"p13s4","text":"t on click. While running the send button (paper-plane line icon) becomes stop (square line icon), t"},{"id":"p13s5","text":"yping turns it back into send (queued send).
- **↑ / ↓ recall your previous inputs** (like a shell, "},{"id":"p13s6","text":"feature request issue #20): press ↑ with the caret at the start of the first line (or in a one-line "},{"id":"p13s7","text":"input) to walk back through everything you have sent, ↓ to walk forward, and ↓ past the newest entry"},{"id":"p13s8","text":" restores whatever you were typing before you started browsing (Esc does the same). Editing a recall"},{"id":"p13s9","text":"ed entry keeps your edit instead of overwriting it, arrow keys still move the caret inside multi-lin"},{"id":"p13s10","text":"e text, and the history survives hiding or reloading the view.
- `/` button (bottom-left): command m"},{"id":"p13s11","text":"enu (plan / compact / goal / feedback / permission / skills / .claude). Most entries insert the comm"},{"id":"p13s12","text":"and into the input (press Enter to run); **Compact context** runs `/compact` straight away and the c"},{"id":"p13s13","text":"onversation shows a live compaction row — a sweep while compacting, then "Compacted N history items "},{"id":"p13s14","text":"(~T tokens)" with the summary expandable, and the compacted range collapses into that row (the same "},{"id":"p13s15","text":"row appears for automatic compaction).
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## 功能总览"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"- **内置聊天参与者 `@dsh`**:VS Code 原生 Chat 面板(Ctrl+Alt+I)输入 `@` 选择 `dsh`;助手回复流式渲染,含工具调用与审批按钮;支持 `/new`、`/s"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"ession <ID>`、`/preset <名>` 斜杠命令。
- **辅助侧栏子 tab**:VS Code ≥ 1.106 时容器直接出现在辅助侧栏(与 ChatGPT 等并列);旧版本自动回退"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"到活动栏图标。
- **独立聊天窗口**:编辑器区 WebviewPanel,命令 `DSH: 打开独立聊天窗口`。
- **现代聊天界面**:大号圆角输入框、胶囊工具栏(思考深度 / 模型 / 预设"},{"id":"p15s4","text":" / 权限),以及输入框右上角、预设胶囊右侧的**上下文进度环**(与网页端一致:点击展开「上下文已用」读数 ~已用 / 上限,以及 系统提示词 / 工具定义 / 对话消息 三段彩色构成与各自 tok"},{"id":"p15s5","text":"en 数)。输入框下方是两枚**会话统计胶囊**(与网页端一致):`4 轮 285 步 · 267 tok/s`(点击展开 会话统计:模型用时 · 工具调用用时 · 首 token 平均 TTFT ·"},{"id":"p15s6","text":" 输出速度 TPS)与 `71M tok · 缓存命中 99.6%`(点击展开 Token 用量:精确总量 · 缓存命中 · 未缓存输入 · 缓存读取/写入 · 输出)。
- **上下文超限提示留在对"},{"id":"p15s7","text":"话里**(issue #19):进度环在 75% 转琥珀、90% 转红(此时面板内提供一键**压缩上下文**);当本次输入预计让上下文越过窗口 90% 时,发送前会在对话里落一张卡片,给出预计读数与*"},{"id":"p15s8","text":"*压缩上下文** / **切换模型**两个动作。若回合仍然失败 —— 提供方以上下文超限报错、回合以 error 结束、或达到输出上限 —— 原因都会写在该回合的对话位置,而不再只闪一条浮动提示;使用"},{"id":"p15s9","text":"窗口较小的模型(MiniMax 等 pi-ai 路由)不会再「悄无声息地失败」。
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"### 前置条件"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"- VS Code ≥ 1.90;内置聊天 `@dsh` 需要 ≥ 1.95;辅助侧栏容器需要 ≥ 1.106(旧版自动回退活动栏)。
- DSH CLI(`dsh`),或允许扩展用 `npx --y"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"es @deepseek-ai/dsh@latest` 自动启动服务器。
- DSH 已配置模型凭证(与 `dsh web` 一致)。"}],"truncated":true}
